# 王文正筆錄

**ID:** KR3l0028
**Custom ID:** ZB3l0025
**Source:** 四庫全書 文淵閣版, V1036.5, p265
**Extent:** 1 卷

## Authors / Editors
- 王曾 (宋朝) 撰 978 - 1033

**Editions:** WYG

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A one-*juàn* record of approximately 30 short entries on Northern-Sòng court matter, by the great early-Sòng chief minister [王曾](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%8E%8B%E6%9B%BE) Wáng Zēng 王曾 (978–1038, *zì* Xiàoxiān 孝先, *shì* Wénzhèng 文正), the senior conservative-Confucian statesman of the early *Rénzōng* reign. The work covers events of the *Tàizǔ*, *Tàizōng*, *Zhēnzōng* and early *Rénzōng* reigns. As the *Sìkù* compilers note, Wáng Zēng was thoroughly versed in court precedent (*liànxí zhǎnggù*) and his statements are largely confirmed by other sources; Lǐ Tāo's *Xù Zīzhì tōngjiàn chángbiān* draws on the work word-for-word in several entries.

**Abstract**

Wáng Zēng (CBDB id 1901; 978–1038) — *Jǐnshì zhuàngyuán* of 1002 (the famous *sānyuán jídì* "winner of all three rounds"); twice chief minister under *Rénzōng*; posthumously *Wénzhèng* and *Yí guógōng*; the model of early-Northern-Sòng Confucian official. His *bǐlù* is, despite its modest size, one of the most documentarily reliable early-Sòng *bǐjì*: the author had direct knowledge of the late-*Zhēnzōng* court (he served at it personally), and his testimony on the *Tānyuān* covenant of 1004–5 (Lǐ Háng's foresight, Wáng Dàn's role) is verified by *Chángbiān*.

The work is among the foundational Northern-Sòng *bǐjì*: with Sīmǎ Guāng's *Sùshuǐ jìwén* [KR3l0030](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR3/KR3l/KR3l0030), Ōuyáng Xiū's *Guītián lù* [KR3l0032](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR3/KR3l/KR3l0032), and Sū Zhé's *Lóngchuān lüèzhì* [KR3l0037](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR3/KR3l/KR3l0037), it forms the core of *Rénzōng* — early-*Shénzōng* anecdotal historiography.

Standard modern edition: collated in Zhōnghuá's *Quán-Sòng bǐjì*; also reproduced in *Sòng shǐliào cóngshū*.
